test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

The village Seoni is located 113 km __away from the capital city of MP, Bhopal.__

options.text: adjacent from city capital of MP, Bhopal
far from the capital city of MP, Bhopal
near from the city capital of MP, Bhopal
proximate from capital of MP, Bhopal

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2) i.e. 'far from the capital city of MP, Bhopal'.**
